name: kimi-code-agent-macos
description: Native macOS local-first Kimi coding agent workbench.

scripts.native:check: cd macos && swift build --product KimiAgentCoreChecks -Xswiftc -disable-batch-mode --jobs 1 && "$(swift build --show-bin-path)/KimiAgentCoreChecks"
scripts.engine:install: npm run build && node scripts/engine-fusion.mjs install
scripts.engine:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/engine-fusion.mjs prepare
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run native:check
